paragraphs: Hyman cites Yoma 76b for the reading given by Dikdukei Soferim: Rabbi Pinchas said in the name of R’ Pinchas of Tzippori. In the reading Hyman calls “our text,” the teacher is Rav Huna of Tzippori. Hyman reports that Yuchasin agreed with Dikdukei Soferim. [Compare Yoma 77b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.77b.17).[^1]

notes.text: Dikdukei Soferim, [p. 246](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/-5otAAAAYAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA8-PA246) and [p. 247, note ק](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/-5otAAAAYAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA8-PA247), gives Huna in the printed-text column and cites Yuchasin for Pinchas of Tzippori. The Davidson passage is at 77b; Hyman prints 76b. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2968&lang=en) cites 77b and suggests that the teacher’s name was Huna. The priority of the readings remains open.
